name: Utah's April Surprise 2019

venue.name: [University of Utah Union Building Saltair Room](https://union.utah.edu/rooms/saltair-room/)
venue.address: 200 Central Campus Dr, Salt Lake City, UT 84112
venue.details: On the main floor in the room behind the trophy case.

information:
This competition is a two-day competition, but most first rounds are held on Saturday.
This competition will feature all events except pyraminx.
Most events will have 2 rounds, but all second and third rounds are held on Sunday.
3x3 One-Handed will be on Sunday the 14th.
Oliver's Twisted Puzzles will be selling puzzles at the event.
 Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need.
